answer: Give each newcomer a single pearl that matures only when three strangers from three unconnected clusters each lend it one plume: a time-limited endorsement that decays within days unless lender and newcomer finish one small real task together. A public atlas maps every endorsement, so closed loops and repeated clusters stand out at once, and a lender who backs two accounts later proven fake forfeits every plume ever given. Forging one identity means winning three independent clusters and keeping those ties alive, while a genuine person simply asks neighbours they already help.
